question: Should Browser CLI `--fields-file` impose a fixed public size limit, and if so what supported threshold and user-facing upgrade behavior should apply?
rationale: The code can enforce any threshold mechanically, but only maintainers can decide whether rejecting formerly valid large field descriptors is an acceptable CLI contract change.

options.title: Set a documented fixed limit
options.body: Choose a supported threshold, document the CLI error and compatibility impact, and retain focused boundary tests.

options.title: Avoid a fixed rejection contract
options.body: Use a safer resource-control approach that preserves existing valid fields-file behavior rather than introducing a new hard size ceiling.

recommendation.title: Set a documented fixed limit
recommendation.body: Choose a supported threshold, document the CLI error and compatibility impact, and retain focused boundary tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a Browser CLI product-contract decision.
